spanish: Y dijo su hermana a hija de Faraón: ¿Iré y te llamaré a ti mujer nodriza de las hebreas, para que te amamante a ti al niño?

findings.issue: לָךְ is benefactive and אֶת הַיָּלֶד the nursed object under hiphil תֵינִק; «te … a ti … al niño» can match that as dative doubling plus DO, but two a-marked phrases also leave an addressee-as-patient reading open.
findings.spanishSpan: te amamante a ti al niño

findings.issue: מִן licenses from/from among the Hebrew women; Spanish «de las hebreas» softens that to of/among without an explicit from-among cue.

notes: Otherwise the Spanish tracks the packet; purpose «para que» for weyiqtol after the cohortative question is licensed.
